narrative: Regreased the slew drive on TR-Z08. This is the third drive in this block requiring attention this quarter. Old grease had dried and separated, cleaned out and repacked with fresh. Backlash measured within spec at all positions checked. This block is 2017 vintage and the drives are all coming due at roughly the same time, which is what I would expect for the hours on them rather than anything wrong with the units. Suggest the remainder of the block gets scheduled proactively rather than waiting for each one to start squealing.
